plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ4): Instructions blocks and the no-MCP fallback
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Since W-INJ1-3, Claude Code, Codex, ACP and OpenCode agents start with an `overdeck` MCP server, but nothing in their launch context tells them it exists, which tools matter, or that wait tools return in 50 s chunks with `next`. Agents without the server (kimi-code, ohmypi, muse, prime-agent, Docker workspaces, mcp.agents: false) are not told the `pan` equivalents either.
narratives.Proposal: Add a leaf module `src/lib/mcp/agent-instructions.ts` with two blocks (MCP block 'Overdeck tools', CLI block 'Overdeck commands', each <= 1,500 characters) and `overdeckInstructionsBlock(overdeckMcp)`. Move the existing injection gate (`harnessGetsOverdeckMcp`, `overdeckMcpEnabledFor`) to a leaf `src/lib/mcp/overdeck-mcp-gate.ts`. `renderManagedLaunchContext` and its materializers take `opts.overdeckMcp` (absent => CLI block) and append the block as the last section; the shared launch file name ends in -mcp.md or -cli.md. The flag is computed from the gate in exactly three places: `claudeSystemPromptFiles` (claude-code, codex, kimi-code, ohmypi), `getAcpLauncherFields` (made async; acp, opencode) and `materializeMuseContext`. Document both blocks. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4935.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Threading the actual mint result into the context; a failed mint still gets the MCP block (PRD H-1).
- Per-role or per-scope variants of the MCP block.
- Injecting the MCP server into AcpRuntime.spawnAgent launches or any no-MCP harness.
- Deleting old <harness>-<hash>.md shared launch files.
- Changing Docker-workspace injection behavior.
- Any line growth in spawn.ts, spawn-prep.ts, spawn-planning-session.ts or conversation-runtime.ts.
- The epic-wide documentation pass (W-DOC, PAN-4958).
- A new *Sync function or a sync/async twin of the gate.

metadata.sizeJustification: Six small items across mcp, context-layers, agents launcher fields, muse runtime and docs; one coherent feature that cannot ship partially.

autoDecisions.summary: Compute the MCP/CLI flag from the existing injection gate (overdeckMcpEnabledFor) instead of threading the injection result from every launch site.
autoDecisions.rationale: The gate is the exact condition every prepare*OverdeckMcp call checks; threading results would touch five god files at their size caps. Only a failed mint diverges, and that path already warns (PRD D-1, H-1).

autoDecisions.summary: An absent flag renders the CLI block.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fail safe: never promise tools a launch may not have; prime-agent and AcpRuntime.spawnAgent inject no server (PRD D-2).

autoDecisions.summary: Move the gate to a leaf module overdeck-mcp-gate.ts and re-export it from agent-injection.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: context-layers must not import the token/registry graph agent-injection.ts pulls in (PRD D-3).

autoDecisions.summary: Make getAcpLauncherFields async and compute the gate inside it.
autoDecisions.rationale: spawn.ts has one spare line under its cap; awaiting in place adds zero lines and keeps the decision in one place (PRD D-4).

autoDecisions.summary: Correct two lines of the epic's verbatim MCP block: wait tools answer running or pending, and a missing tool means the role lacks the scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: secret_wait and link_machine_wait answer pending; review/test/ship tokens lack operate so delegate_task and done are hidden (PRD D-8).

autoDecisions.summary: Muse gets the tools block through its own composer.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic D-13 names muse as a CLI-block harness and muse-context.ts never calls renderManagedLaunchContext (PRD W-5).
